Banyan Tree Grand Residences Seaview

Condominium in Laguna Phuket (Bang Tao Beach)
HomeSaleBanyan Tree Grand Residences Seaview

Developer marketing renders (artist impressions). Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Banyan Tree Grand Residences Seaview Residences is a low-rise, four-storey collection of three-bedroom residences inside Laguna Phuket, next to the Banyan Tree Phuket hotel and a short walk from Bang Tao Beach. Units are large for a condominium, about 354 to 498 sqm, with private decks and pools; the top-floor penthouses have rooftop pools with views of the Andaman Sea. Residents reach the hotel by a private walkway.

The residences are run under the Banyan Tree brand. Owners join the group's Sanctuary Club and the Laguna Advantage programme, and have use of the Laguna resort facilities, including the 18-hole Laguna Golf course about 400 m away. A show unit opened in January 2025.

Foreign buyers can buy within the 49% foreign freehold quota. Agent listings give completion as Q1 2026 but do not confirm handover, so ask us for the current status.
